title: Memory Garden
subtitle: A journey to reclaim forgotten moments

steps.title: The Garden is Misty
steps.text: Grandma, the garden is a bit foggy lately. Some flowers are hard to see, but don't worry, let's take it slow.

steps.title: Watch the Flowers
steps.text: Flowers will bloom one by one. Please watch them carefully.
steps.sub: Each flower stays for a moment

steps.title: Find the Echo
steps.text: If you see a flower that is the EXACT SAME as the one before...

steps.title: Press the Button
steps.text: When you spot a repeating flower, gently press the "Déjà vu" button.
steps.sub: It's okay if you miss one, we are just strolling.
